reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: Actually, I had downloaded this app before. However, I hadn't really explored it much. I deleted it right away because of the energy shortage issue. Now, seeing it again and checking the reviews, I thought I'd give it another chance. But I regret it. This app appears to be free, but it definitely isn't. The ads are beyond being just a problem. At the same time, if you are using it for free, you are supposed to get energy once every 24 hours. They create the impression that you can practice once a day, but that's not how it works either. They don't actually give you any energy. If you watch 3 long ads, they give you one energy. If you don't watch them, you get nothing. So, they don't even give you a chance to try the app and see whether you like it or not. It would make more sense if the app were offered as a paid one directly. I also looked at the reviews. There are constant complaints about ads, and they've replied to everyone, thanking them and saying they will forward the feedback. But when I examine the recent update notes for the app, no changes have been made. In other words, there is actually no attempt showing they intend to fix this situation. It's almost as if they have an attitude of "use it if you want, don't use it if you don't."

reviews.title: big fan of the app, starting to find very annoying bugs.
reviews.text:
i’ve been using this app for almost a year now! it’s a lot of fun, i really enjoy the daily multiplayer drawings. here recently i’ve gone in to personalize my account and i noticed some options aren’t available to me as you have to have a “PRO” subscription. my problem with that, is i HAVE a pro subscription. i paid $52 fo it last year, and im not wanting to pay for it again if the app can just randomly decide to take benefits from me that i have *already paid for*. on top of that, i’ve noticed, since the option to change your profile character/color has become available, it’s incredibly glitchy. i will select the color and the character icon i want, and save it. it’s fine for the rest of that day, but after closing the app and reopening it, sometimes it completely erases my selection. 

i’m getting incredibly frustrated with these bugs and they’re pushing me to delete this app and not renew my subscription next month.

reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for a couple years now. i tried
The free version before purchasing the pro and each corse category had at least one picture for free and a daily free lesson. I did purchase the pro version and it wasn’t too expensive, everything was good until my year subscription ended. I went to renew the subscription and saw they upped the prices to what for me was a bit much and I also saw they got rid of all the free corses except the daily free one. I was upset about this change then I saw they started using some sort of energy system for the free version and upped the price twice as much and are now offering the first upped price as “our lowest price ever” as a discounted price showing the usual price being twice as expensive from when I first got this app. I’m even more upset and disappointed idk what they are doing with this app when it used to be sooo good but it seems like they are just completely ruining it. It used to be the best drawing app on the App Store now it fits right in with the rest of the trash drawing apps.
